BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, gnṓstēs is the word for expert. In Acts 26:3, the text says "Especially [because I know] thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, gnṓstēs, does its job quietly — expert — and I leave it at that.
RelatedEvents: Paul Before Felix, Festus, and Agrippa
